messages:
Anya: Quick kickoff 1 Q3 inbound campaign needs visuals. Deliverables: landing hero, three benchmark tiles, a compact routing diagram for SDR handoff, and one webinar hero slide. Deadline: final assets by Friday EOD.
Mira: Copy that. Can you list the exact scenarios to depict in the hero + the metrics for the tiles?
Anya: Scenarios: A) social post -> landing capture, B) webinar signup -> cohort nurture, C) benchmark teaser (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Metrics for tiles below.
Sam: For the routing diagram: anything scoring >=60 should trigger immediate SDR assignment + a Slack ping to #sdr-high. Scores under 60 go into a 7-day nurture drip.
Jackie: Brand rules: use new palette (navy, coral, muted-green). Typography: Inter scale, H1 48 semibold. Icons: flat, two-color. Tiles should be minimal: icon, three numbers, single-line insight.
Mira: Please paste metrics so I can mock the sparkline and proportions.
Anya: Benchmarks: Hosted p50 latency 85ms, cost $0.0025/token. Dedicated p50 65ms, cost $0.0016/token. Private p50 72ms, cost $0.0020/token. Callout: Dedicated yields best cost-per-token at scale.
Jackie: Tone for takeaway: "Unified API, predictable economics." Use that as the short line under each tile.
Mira: Localization: only en-US and en-GB variants this pass?
Anya: Yes, US EN and EU EN. Keep copy short.
Sam: Here's the product team's routing YAML to reflect in the visual layout if helpful:
```
routes:
  - name: high_intent
    match: score >= 60
    action: send_to_sdr_queue + slack_alert(#sdr-high)
  - name: nurture
    match: score < 60
    action: add_to_drip(days=7)
```
Mira: Great, I'll design a flow with a tiny legend and arrow styles.
Anya: Deliverable specs: Figma with separate pages for hero, tiles, routing diagram. PNGs: 1200x628 (social), 640x360 (thumbnail), 1920x1080 (webinar hero). Include localization-ready text layers.
Mira: First drafts by Thursday noon, final by Friday EOD. Need legal okay on the benchmark wording.
Anya: @Leo can you review the phrasing for compliance?
Leo: I will check Thursday afternoon. Note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest". Use "most cost-efficient at scale" and add a footnote: "Based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025."
Jackie: We'll prep a legal-friendly footnote and ensure type contrasts meet accessibility.
Mira: Icon style confirmed: flat 2-color fills, thin strokes. Any preference for the tiny fallback badge we discussed?
Anya: Add a small fallback badge in the corner of the benchmark tile: icon + text "fallback to compatible model variants". Helps signal robustness.
Sam: CTAs: Hero -> "Register for benchmark webinar", Tiles -> small link text "Read the full benchmark". Add space for UTM examples utm_campaign=cohort_q3&utm_source=social.
Mira: Noted. design-bot, create an asset checklist please.
design-bot: Asset checklist created: [Figma master file, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, source SVG icons, localization-ready text layers, export manifest].
Mira: Uploading draft link in a few mins.
Anya: Once draft is live I'll do a copy pass. Jackie will run brand QA and Leo will confirm legal phrasing.
Jackie: I'll do a brand sweep Thu evening. If green, we hand to growth for scheduling.
Mira: Draft uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/Inbound-Campaign-Visuals 1 comments enabled on frames.
Anya: Please leave feedback on figma comments rather than long Slack replies.
Sam: Reminder: Paid channel assets needed by Mon AM; Friday EOD final fits.
Mira: Adding figma tokens page for colors and type, and separate layer for localized copy.
Jackie: Adding accessibility checklist to the figma file as well.
Leo: I'll look at the benchmark copy after Jackie finishes brand QA.
Anya: Thanks everyone. We'll sync if any blockers show up. :rocket:
